title: manni content strategy: audience record
description: A content-strategy audience: a group of readers the docs serve. One record per file, under docs/content-strategy/audiences/. Every field after `type` and `id` is optional.

type.description: Marks the file as an audience record, which `manni strategy` reads.

id.description: The id pages and other records name this record by. Unique across every record.

title.description: The record's name, as `manni strategy list` and `get` show it.

description.description: One sentence that says who or what the record is.

segment.description: The segment in one line, such as the team that owns the docs and the state of the corpus.

maturity.description: The company stage or size the audience spans.

docs-owner.description: Who owns the docs in this audience.

firmographics.description: Traits of the organisations in the audience.

relationship-stages.description: The relationship stages the audience covers, such as prospect or customer.

personas.description: The ids of the persona records that belong to this audience. `manni strategy` derives the same list from each persona's `audience:`, so this one is optional.

features-emphasized.description: The features this audience cares most about.

underrepresented.description: Whether the docs serve this audience less than its weight.
